_comment: Claude Desktop MCP server configuration template. After installing the Claude desktop app, this file lives at ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). Per-project copies live at .claude/claude_desktop_config.json.
_comment_single_source_of_truth: Maintain runtimes/mcp/servers.yaml as the canonical inventory. Run runtimes/mcp/render/render_claude.py to regenerate this file from servers.yaml.

env._comment: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your shell profile or in .env (gitignored). Do NOT hardcode it here.
